title: Chat Support Executive - Non Voice Process
description:
**Chat Support Executive – Non-Voice Process**

**Job Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Work from Office  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Interview Mode:** Walk-in  
**Salary:** ₹26,000 – ₹38,000 CTC per month

**About the Role**

We are looking for **Chat Support Executive** to join our Customer Experience team. This opportunity is open to **both freshers and experienced candidates** who have strong written communication skills, good computer knowledge, and a customer-focused approach.

The selected candidates will interact with customers through digital communication channels, understand their concerns, provide appropriate solutions, and ensure a smooth and professional customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle customer queries through **chat, email, text, and social media platforms**.
* Understand customer concerns and provide accurate and timely resolutions.
* Assist customers with information related to products, services, and processes.
* Maintain high standards of **written English, grammar, spelling, and professional communication**.
* Handle customer complaints with patience, empathy, and professionalism.
* Record customer interactions and maintain accurate customer information.
* Follow company policies, processes, and quality standards.
* Achieve assigned **quality, productivity, response-time, and customer satisfaction targets**.
* Coordinate with internal teams whenever required to resolve customer concerns.
* Manage multiple conversations simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and service quality.

**Eligibility & Requirements**

* Minimum qualification: **12th Pass / Diploma or equivalent**; graduates are preferred.
* **Freshers are welcome to apply.**
* Previous experience in customer service, chat support, BPO, or customer experience will be an added advantage.
* Excellent **written English and grammar skills**.
* Good typing speed and basic computer proficiency.
* Strong problem-solving and attention-to-detail skills.
* Ability to multitask and handle multiple customer conversations.
* Willingness to work in **rotational shifts**, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
* **Candidates must be willing to relocate to Ahmedabad and work from the office.**

**What We Offer**

* Comprehensive training and onboarding support.
* Opportunities for learning and professional development.
* Career growth and internal advancement opportunities.
* Supportive and professional work environment.
* Opportunity to strengthen customer service and communication skills.
* Long-term career opportunities in the Customer Experience and Support domain.

**Who Can Apply?**

This opportunity is ideal for **freshers and experienced professionals** who have strong written communication skills, basic computer knowledge, a customer-oriented mindset, and are willing to relocate to Ahmedabad.

**Interested candidates can apply now and take the next step toward building a career in Customer Experience and Support.**

Pay: ₹26,000.00 - ₹38,000.00 per month

title: Performance Marketer
description:
Performance Marketer

**Experience:** 2\+ Years  
**Location:** Makarba, Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Mode:** On\-site

About the Role

We are looking for a **Performance Marketer** with 2\+ years of experience who can plan, execute, optimize, and scale digital advertising campaigns across multiple platforms. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of performance marketing, analytics, conversion optimization, and ROI\-driven campaigns.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan and execute performance marketing campaigns across **Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other relevant platforms**.
* Manage campaign budgets and optimize spending to achieve maximum **ROI/ROAS**.
* Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, competitor analysis, and market research.
* Create and test different ad copies, creatives, audiences, and landing pages.
* Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Analyze key metrics such as **CPC, CPM, CTR, CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, and customer acquisition cost**.
* Prepare regular performance reports and provide actionable insights.
* Conduct **A/B testing** to improve campaign performance and conversion rates.
* Work closely with the **content, design, sales, and development teams** to improve campaign outcomes.
* Track leads, conversions, and customer journeys using tools such as **Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking**.
* Stay updated with the latest digital advertising trends, platform updates, and performance marketing strategies.

Requirements

* **2\+ years of hands\-on experience in Performance Marketing/Digital Advertising.**
* Strong experience with **Google Ads and Meta Ads**.
* Good understanding of campaign optimization, audience targeting, and conversion tracking.
* Experience in managing and optimizing advertising budgets.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven approach.
* Knowledge of **Google Analytics/GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Looker Studio** is an advantage.
* Ability to analyse campaign data and make strategic decisions.
* Good communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working with international or global clients will be an added advantage.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on diverse digital marketing campaigns.
* Growth and learning opportunities.
* Collaborative and professional work environment.
* Performance\-based career growth.

**Location:** Makarba, Ahmedabad  
**Experience:** 2\+ Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site

Pay: ₹13,159\.86 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

description:
**Job Title: Performance Marketer**

The ideal candidate is a proactive leader with multi\-channel expertise and the ability to manage campaigns end\-to\-end with a strong focus on ROI.

* Manage and optimize campaigns across SEO, SEM, Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and social media platforms.
* Oversee content marketing initiatives including blogs, case studies, website updates, and email campaigns.

* Lead and manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and deliverables efficiently.

title: Digital Marketer
description:
**Social Media ExecutiveLocation: Iskon, Ahmedabad (On\-site)**  
**Experience: 1 to 3 Years**  
**Shift Timing: 12 PM to 9 PM**

**Note:** Experience with Meta Pixel, Events Manager, conversion tracking, and basic campaign attribution is a must.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a creative and results\-driven **Social Media Executive** to manage and grow our social media presence and support paid social media campaigns. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in **social media management, content creation, Meta Ads, audience engagement, and performance analytics**.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Develop and execute social media strategies aligned with business and marketing objectives.

· Manage day\-to\-day activities across platforms such as **Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and YouTube**.

· Create, curate, and publish engaging social media content, including posts, reels, stories, carousels, and videos.

· Prepare and maintain a **social media content calendar** to ensure consistent and timely publishing.

· Write compelling captions, post copy, hashtags, and other social media content.

· Plan, set up, manage, and optimise **Meta Ads campaigns across Facebook and Instagram**.

· Conduct audience research and create relevant **Meta Ads audiences, custom audiences, lookalike audiences, and retargeting campaigns**.

· Monitor Meta Ads performance and optimise campaigns based on **CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL, conversions, ROAS, and other relevant KPIs**.

· Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors, content writers, and other teams to develop social media and advertising creatives.

· Monitor social media trends, competitor activities, industry developments, and emerging content formats.

· Engage with followers, respond to comments and messages, and support community management.

· Track and analyse organic and paid social media performance using platform analytics and reporting tools.

· Prepare regular performance reports covering reach, engagement, followers, website traffic, leads, conversions, and paid campaign performance.

· Identify opportunities to improve engagement, reach, brand visibility, lead generation, and audience growth.

· Conduct **A/B testing of ad creatives, copy, audiences, placements, and campaign objectives** to improve campaign performance.

· Coordinate with the marketing and sales teams to ensure social media\-generated leads are properly tracked and followed up.

· Conduct hashtag, audience, competitor, and content research to improve organic and paid performance.

· Ensure all social media communication and advertising follows the company's brand guidelines and tone of voice.

**Required Skills**

· **1–3 years of hands\-on experience in social media management and digital marketing.**

· Strong knowledge of major social media platforms, particularly **Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn**.

· Hands\-on experience with **Meta Ads Manager** and managing Facebook/Instagram advertising campaigns.

· Good understanding of **campaign setup, targeting, retargeting, audience creation, budget allocation, bidding, ad placements, and campaign optimisation**.

· Ability to analyse Meta Ads performance using metrics such as **CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL, conversion rate, and ROAS**.

· Experience with **Meta Pixel, Events Manager, conversion tracking, and basic campaign attribution** is a must.

· Strong copywriting and content\-writing abilities.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

· Understanding of social media analytics and key performance metrics.

· Basic knowledge of tools such as **Canva, Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, and social media scheduling platforms**.

· Ability to identify trends and convert them into relevant content ideas.

· Strong organisational and time\-management skills.

· Creative mindset with attention to detail.

· Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Bachelor's degree in **Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Mass Communication, or a related field**.

· Experience managing social media accounts for **B2B, B2C, SaaS, IT, or service\-based businesses** is a plus.

· Experience in **lead\-generation campaigns through Meta Ads** will be an advantage.

· Experience with short\-form video content, reels, and social media campaigns.

· Basic understanding of **SEO, Google Ads, and broader digital marketing** is preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

· Social media reach and impressions

· Engagement rate

· Follower/audience growth

· Content performance

· Website traffic from social channels

· Leads and conversions generated through social media

· **Meta Ads CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL, conversion rate, and ROAS**

· Cost per lead/acquisition

· Community engagement and response rate

· Consistency and quality of content publishing

· Overall contribution to brand awareness and lead generation

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
